subject: Focus-dependent terminal glow, dimmer inactive text, adjustable fading letters and grouped GAUGES in a separate native testing build.
reader: Parker asked for these TD appearance controls and wants to try them; he knows panes and GAUGES but does not read Rust.

sections.heading: Terminal Light
sections.text:
You asked for more glow and dimmer text in inactive panes, plus the fading letters missing from the first build. Your test window on workspace 4 now has both, with organised GAUGES. The new tab uses OPS and your captured picture settings. 

 01 · FOCUS 

ACTIVE 15% Original text intensity 

INACTIVE 65% 75% of the active text setting 
 Figure 1. Inactive letters have a wider halo and a dimmer core. These are native GPU captures from matching terminal content. Click either pane in the test window to swap the treatment. The 75% value scales the text-intensity setting. measured

sections.heading: Afterglow
sections.text:
New text appears immediately. Replaced letters fade at their previous positions for 180 milliseconds by default. The slider runs from 0 to 1,200 ms; zero clears the trail. Letter glow and afterglow also work with CRT glass switched off. 
 02 · REPLACED LETTERS 
Early · about 0.2 seconds after replacement 
 Early Middle Finished 
 Figure 2. The old A shapes fade while the new B shapes stay sharp. Recorded native frames with the fade dial temporarily at 1,000 ms, so the stages are easy to compare. At roughly 0.6 seconds, the remaining pixel difference was one third of the early frame’s; the neighboring pane changed by zero pixels. The buttons choose recorded frames. measured

sections.heading: GAUGES
sections.text:
The light controls now sit in their own groups. Use the bottom bar’s GAUGES for inherited settings, or a pane’s GAUGES to pin its own values. 
 03 · THE NATIVE PANEL 

 TYPE Text size, bench size, menu size. 
 PICTURE Brightness, contrast, colour, background, gamma and border phosphor. 
 ACTIVE TERMINALS Text intensity and letter glow. 
 INACTIVE TERMINALS Relative text level and letter glow. 
 AFTERGLOW How long replaced letters linger. 
 TEXT CRAWL · CRT GLASS The existing controls remain expandable. 
 Figure 3. All five main groups fit in the native panel at the tested window size. This capture uses a neutral picture grade for legibility; the test window keeps your current picture grade. Close GAUGES to see GPU letter glow: the existing tray preview limitation remains. measured

sections.heading: The trail
sections.text:
Each pane retains only its replaced glyphs. A scroll, resize, theme or focus change, screen-buffer switch, hidden tab or covered terminal clears those old positions. 
 04 · ONE PANE 
 Figure 4. Afterglow reuses the current render path and has a per-pane memory bound. Drawn from Trail::observe , GridPaint and the existing bloom shader. Heavy-output frame timing still needs qualification before promotion . code-derived

sections.heading: Testing
sections.text:
The isolated fixture replaced letters in one pane while holding its neighbor still. Deterministic tests also drove real GPUI focus changes, immediate replacement, timed expiry and covering the terminal. | 
 | Check | Result 
 | Compiled defaults versus explicitly setting 15 / 65 / 75 / 180 | Native text regions match exactly. 
 | Fade at zero | Early and late regions match exactly. 
 | Default / fallback core | 2,606 / 2,553 tests passed; 10 ignored in each suite. 
 | Build and lint | Locked release build, format and both Clippy gates passed. 
 | Settings and ownership | Unset remains distinct from zero; new dials pin independently and reset to their defaults. 
 | Two native restarts | Explicit zero and per-pane inactive glow, text level and fade time survive; the neighbor stays unchanged. 
Evidence: native timing · pixel comparisons · restart checks · test counts and commands · running instance and preserved shells . Captures qualify these fixtures on this machine; other GPUs and heavy-output frame cost remain unmeasured.

sections.heading: Your window
sections.text:
Switch to workspace 4 and the TERMINAL LIGHT tab. Both new panes are interactive shells. Click between them, try the new sliders, then run this command in either pane to watch replacements: 
afterglow-demo 
The earlier test tab and both of its shell processes are preserved. Relaunch the separate test window with: 
sh /home/parker/Work/td-phosphor-glow-lab/native-lab/launch.sh 

 Inactive readability 
Inactive text starts at 75% of the active setting. Try your dense output with 65% glow and leave a note here if you want that text level changed.
